title: An invitation to the cinema
context_es: Quieres ir al cine este fin de semana e invitas por mensaje a tu amiga Nora.
prompt_en: You want to go to the cinema this weekend. Write a message to your friend Nora.
points: invite Nora and say which film you want to see
say when and where to meet
suggest what to do after the film
tips_es: Para invitar: *Would you like to* + verbo.
Para proponer un plan: *Let’s meet at seven.* / *We can have dinner.*
model_answer:
Hi Nora,

Are you free on Friday evening? I want to see the new space film at the Royal Cinema. Would you like to come with me? Let's meet at half past six outside the cinema, because the film starts at seven. Then we can have a pizza near the station.

Let me know!
Irene
